_comment: Mutation survivors accepted as a baseline for the core sweep. The nightly ratchet fails when a survivor appears outside this set, and when an entry is no longer a survivor. Regenerate with `python scripts/mutation_gate.py --baseline core --update` after a sweep, and only ever let this set shrink. Entries are the survivor line without its line:col position, so they survive unrelated code motion.
survivors: crates/valgebra-core/src/ir.rs: replace SeqRegex::any_elem -> bool with false

_accepted.crates/valgebra-core/src/decision.rs: re: Region's NONE_TYPE is `1 << 0`, and `1 >> 0` is the same value. A genuinely equivalent mutant: the other six shift constants are killed by `the_scalar_regions_partition_the_universe`, which requires each region to be non-empty and pairwise disjoint.
_accepted.crates/valgebra-core/src/ir.rs: replace: Equivalent only because the guardedness check is its single caller, and that check is constantly false under a crossed structural constructor (`structural_constructors_absorb_the_guard`). That is a fact about the call graph rather than about the argument, so this one stays IN the sweep on purpose: a second caller would make an exclusion wrong without touching either function, and this survivor is where that would surface.
